summary: Frontend-only testing of 3 new features: Forgot Password page, Reset Password page, and Dashboard Plan Usage Card. All 8 requested scenarios PASSED. Login -> forgot-password link nav works; forgot-password form submits and shows 'Reset link sent!' with masked/generic message including entered email; reset-password without token shows 'Invalid Reset Link' + working 'Request New Reset Link' CTA; reset-password with fake token renders form, client-side mismatch validation works, and backend returns 400 with 'Invalid or expired reset token' surfaced in the UI. Dashboard PlanUsageCard loads from GET /api/tenants/plan-usage (200), shows all 4 metrics (Jobs 0/50, Team Members 1/1, Branches 1/1, Inventory 0/50), 'Near Limits' badge (triggered by 1/1 team/branches) and 'Upgrade to Pro' button which navigates to /billing.

integration_issues.issue: GET /api/tenants/plan-usage is fired twice on dashboard mount (duplicate request). Likely React StrictMode double-invoke or PlanUsageCard mounted/re-rendered twice; harmless but wasteful.

issues: Tailwind class names are built via string interpolation (`[&>div]:${bgColor}` and `${bgColor}/10`) in PlanUsageCard.jsx lines 165 & 177. These classes are not statically analyzable by Tailwind's JIT/purge, so per-metric colors (blue/green/purple/orange) and the icon tint backgrounds never render - bars fall back to default primary and icon chips have no background. Use an explicit class map instead.

Reset Password: entering a password shorter than 6 chars relies on native HTML minLength validation (browser tooltip); the custom 'Password must be at least 6 characters long' error never appears. Acceptable but inconsistent with the styled error box used for mismatch.

action_items: Replace interpolated Tailwind classes in PlanUsageCard.jsx with a static class map so progress bar / icon colors render
De-duplicate the /api/tenants/plan-usage fetch on dashboard mount (optional)
critical_code_review_comments: PlanUsageCard: no error UI state - on API failure it silently returns null (only console.error). Add an error/empty state so admins know usage could not load.
ForgotPassword/ResetPassword import useTranslation but never use `t`; all copy is hardcoded English while the rest of app is i18n-enabled.
seed_data_creation: None. Used existing demo tenant (demo / admin@demo.com). A password reset token was generated for admin@demo.com via forgot-password but was not consumed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 3 new features verified working end-to-end on the preview URL. Remaining items are cosmetic (Tailwind dynamic class interpolation in PlanUsageCard) and a duplicate plan-usage fetch. Backend forgot/reset password endpoints already have pytest coverage in /app/backend/tests/test_email_integration.py.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A - no functional defects found. Dynamic Tailwind class issue root cause: Tailwind only emits classes it finds as literal strings in source; template-literal composed classes such as `[&>div]:${bgColor}` are never emitted to the CSS bundle.
